Description / Value: Nano ESP32 - Arduino Nano ESP32 with headers (left pin row; right row in J2)
Notes: One module, two pin rows: J1 = left row (pin 1 = D13), J2 = right row (pin 1 = D12). USB-C toward the board edge marked USB. Solder the Nano's headers directly into J1 and J2, seated flat; NO sockets
Normally-CLOSED type; do not substitute a normally-open relay
Through-hole SIP-4; Murata MEE1S0305SC is a pin-compatible alternative
